abstract: A 60-year-old female presented with the main complaints of hematuria, pain upon urination, and pollakiuria. Simple abdominal X-rays revealed a dumb bell-shaped calculus shadow, and a calculus was detected in the right posterior wall by cystoscopy. At surgery, a left ovarian dermoid cyst accompanied by a calculus that was adhesive and perforating in the right posterior wall of bladder was detected. Twenty-eight cases of ovarian dermoid cyst with bladder perforation including this case are reported.
abstract_ja: 60歳の女性が血尿、排尿時痛、頻尿を主訴に来院した。単純腹部X線で亜鈴状の結石影を認め、膀胱鏡で右後壁に結石が確認された。手術では、右膀胱後壁に癒着し穿孔した結石を伴う左卵巣類皮嚢腫が認められた。本例を含め、膀胱穿孔を伴う卵巣類皮嚢腫の28例を報告する。
